title: Frontend Product Builder Screen Specification
description: Executable planning contract for one frontend screen or bounded interaction surface.

visualHierarchy.description: Required by the workflow 2.2 composition validator for substantial frontend work.

semanticPresentation.description: Explicit screen-level mapping from semantic data roles to component usages. Registry mode must resolve through design-system.json#visualGrammar.perceptualPolicy.presentationRoles; absence remains unresolved rather than inferred from prose.

decisionSupport.description: Canonical screen decision question and required rendered signals. Absence remains unresolved.

wayfinding.description: Canonical navigation relation for drill-down or active-navigation orientation. Absence remains unresolved.

scopeHierarchy.description: Ordered ancestor-to-descendant scope levels for this product (e.g. ['tenant','client','case','process']). Required whenever the product has a nested entity hierarchy where a finer-grained entity has siblings sharing a coarser ancestor id. Each dataDependency.scopeResolution.requestedLevel and .allowedForLevels must reference a level declared here.

visitorMode.description: Explicit craft visitor mode for a project-owned recipe/category that has no canonical policy mapping. Canonical policy mappings cannot be overridden.

sharedSelectorId.description: Canonical, exported selector/computation name this component reads its derived value from. Required whenever the same action id or the same semantic derived value (status, severity, eligibility) is exposed by more than one componentUsage/screen-spec — every such usage must declare the same sharedSelectorId, never an independently recomputed value.

guardFunction.description: Canonical, exported pure function name this component calls to compute an action's eligibility/guard result. Required whenever this componentUsage exposes an action also exposed elsewhere (e.g. a list-row quick action and the same action's dialog/detail control) — both must declare the same guardFunction, and the mutation/execution handler must re-invoke it immediately before mutating rather than trusting a UI-computed flag.

referenceResolution.description: For a componentUsage that cites/links another domain object: 'routed' when a real route exists and is in this slice's scope (render as a native link/Link with a resolvable href); 'overlay-resolved' when no route exists yet or the route is out of this slice's scope (render as a non-navigational trigger opening a centralized, single-selector-resolved overlay, never a dead '#' href or a guessed route).

referenceUtility.description: Required when semanticRole is reusable-reference. Utility remains explicit instead of inferred from styling.

scopeKey.description: The exact foreign key this dependency filters by (e.g. 'caseId'), never a coarser ancestor key (e.g. 'clientId') when the screen is a detail view of the finer-grained entity. Required whenever productContext.scope.scopeHierarchy is declared and this screen is a detail view of a non-root level.

originField.description: Where each displayed item's provenance/parent chain comes from (e.g. a resolved origin object naming case/process/event). Required for any dependency that consolidates items reached through more than one relation chain (e.g. a client-level 360/consolidated view).

requestedLevel.description: Which level of productContext.scope.scopeHierarchy this dependency reads at.

resolvedVia.description: 'exact-parent-chain': every item is reached by walking explicit parent-id references down to requestedLevel, never inferred from a coarser shared key. 'ancestor-aggregate': items are gathered by a broader/ancestor key (e.g. clientId) and therefore may include siblings; only valid on a dependency explicitly designated as a consolidated/360 view, and every aggregated item must carry its own derived originField.

allowedForLevels.description: Levels from scopeHierarchy that may legitimately consume an 'ancestor-aggregate' dependency (normally only the ancestor level itself, e.g. a client-level dossier). A screen whose own classification is a descendant level must not declare a dependency with resolvedVia 'ancestor-aggregate' unless its own level appears here.

sharedSelectorId.description: Canonical, exported selector/computation name that produces this dependency's derived value (e.g. a status, severity, or count). Required whenever the same semantic value is rendered by more than one screen-spec under docs/frontend/screens/ (e.g. a list screen and that entity's own detail screen) — every such screen-spec must declare the same sharedSelectorId for that value, never an independently reimplemented formula.

mutabilityPolicy.description: For a mutation-type dependency: whether the target entity may be overwritten in place ('mutable'), must remain immutable once created with changes captured only as new linked records ('append-only-linked'), or is explicitly versioned ('versioned'). Required for any mutation dependency whose purpose implies validating, approving, or certifying a document or other evidentiary/audit-sensitive record.

emptyKind.description: Operational meaning of category=empty. Required by Phase 5 evidence when an empty state is exercised.

reasonKind.description: Disjoint classification of why the action is disabled, separate from the free-text 'reason'. A dependency the action itself will resolve must never be classified 'business-block'. Strongly recommended for any disabledAction whose screen also uses a confidence-qualifier prefix (e.g. 'Candidato') elsewhere, so pending-human-decision/dependency are never confused with a confirmed business-block.

targetRoute.description: For kind: 'navigation', the exact route path this action navigates to. Must not be a placeholder ('#', 'javascript:void(0)') or a guessed path; must exist in the project's real route inventory.

referenceResolution.description: Same contract as componentUsage.referenceResolution. For kind: 'navigation', 'routed' requires targetRoute to name a real, in-scope route; 'overlay-resolved' means no route exists yet and this action opens a resolver-backed overlay instead.

guardChecks.description: Itemized, disjoint guard checklist evaluated by one shared pure function (see componentUsage.guardFunction) before this action is eligible. Required when kind is 'mutation' or 'destructive' and the action's effect is a decision, approval, or conflict resolution.

auditTrail.description: Durable audit-record contract for this action. Required (required: true, capturedFields including at least actor/timestamp/justification/result, correlationIdRequired: true) when the action's successBehavior/label indicates a decision, approval, or conflict resolution; a conflict resolution must additionally capture 'rejectedAlternative'.
